examples.zh: 启动前，双方批准了工作说明书。
examples.en: Both parties approved the statement of work before kickoff.

examples.zh: 工作说明书规定了交付成果。
examples.en: The statement of work defines deliverables.

examples.zh: 签署前，法务审查了条款与条件。
examples.en: Legal reviewed the terms and conditions before signature.

examples.zh: 仔细阅读条款与条件。
examples.en: Read the terms and conditions carefully.

examples.zh: 我们协商了间接损失的责任限制。
examples.en: We negotiated a limitation of liability for indirect losses.

examples.zh: 责任限制需要审查。
examples.en: The limitation of liability needs review.

examples.zh: 请与法律顾问核对赔偿条款。
examples.en: Please check the indemnity clause with legal counsel.

examples.zh: 赔偿条款涵盖特定索赔。
examples.en: The indemnity clause covers specified claims.

examples.zh: 供应商只有提供证据才能援引不可抗力。
examples.en: The supplier may invoke force majeure only with evidence.

examples.zh: 合同界定了不可抗力事件。
examples.en: The contract defines force majeure events.

examples.zh: 终止条款要求提前三十天通知。
examples.en: The termination clause requires thirty days' notice.

examples.zh: 终止条款规定了通知要求。
examples.en: The termination clause specifies notice requirements.

examples.zh: 反复不交货可能构成违约。
examples.en: Repeated non-delivery may constitute a breach of contract.

examples.zh: 投诉指称存在违约。
examples.en: The complaint alleges breach of contract.

examples.zh: 协议允许十天补救期限。
examples.en: The agreement allows a ten-day cure period.

examples.zh: 补救期限于周五结束。
examples.en: The cure period ends on Friday.

examples.zh: 合同明确规定了适用法律。
examples.en: The contract clearly states the governing law.

examples.zh: 双方讨论了适用法律。
examples.en: Both parties discussed the governing law.

examples.zh: 未经批准，不要订立有约束力的协议。
examples.en: Do not enter into a binding agreement without approval.

examples.zh: 草案不是有约束力的协议。
examples.en: A draft is not a binding agreement.

examples.zh: 采购前，质量部门完成了供应商资格认定。
examples.en: Quality completed supplier qualification before sourcing.

examples.zh: 供应商资格认定包含现场审计。
examples.en: Supplier qualification includes a site audit.

examples.zh: 新来源尚未列入合格供应商名单。
examples.en: The new source is not yet on the approved vendor list.

examples.zh: 先检查合格供应商名单。
examples.en: Check the approved vendor list first.

examples.zh: 我们对关键零件采用了双源采购。
examples.en: We adopted dual sourcing for the critical component.

examples.zh: 双源采购提高供应灵活性。
examples.en: Dual sourcing improves supply flexibility.

examples.zh: 重新设计减少了我们的单一来源依赖。
examples.en: The redesign reduces our sole-source dependency.

examples.zh: 单一来源依赖增加交付风险敞口。
examples.en: Sole-source dependency increases delivery exposure.

examples.zh: 我们每季度审查供应商绩效评分卡。
examples.en: We review the supplier scorecard each quarter.

examples.zh: 供应商绩效评分卡包含交付表现。
examples.en: The supplier scorecard includes delivery performance.

examples.zh: 委员会采用加权标准进行了评标。
examples.en: The committee conducted a bid evaluation using weighted criteria.

examples.zh: 技术审查后开始评标。
examples.en: Bid evaluation begins after technical review.

examples.zh: 请澄清商务报价是否包含运费。
examples.en: Please clarify whether freight is included in the commercial offer.

examples.zh: 商务报价本月到期。
examples.en: The commercial offer expires this month.

examples.zh: 工程部门将技术方案与价格分开评估。
examples.en: Engineering assessed the technical offer separately from price.

examples.zh: 技术方案符合规格。
examples.en: The technical offer meets the specification.

examples.zh: 更好的需求数据增强了我们的谈判立场。
examples.en: Better demand data strengthened our negotiation position.

examples.zh: 备用来源增强了我们的谈判地位。
examples.en: A backup source strengthens our negotiation position.

examples.zh: 我们比较了三个来源的到岸总成本。
examples.en: We compared landed cost across the three sources.

examples.zh: 关税增加了到岸总成本。
examples.en: Duty increases the landed cost.

examples.zh: 计划人员提高了旺季安全库存水平。
examples.en: The planner raised the safety stock level for peak season.

examples.zh: 安全库存吸收意外需求。
examples.en: Safety stock absorbs unexpected demand.

examples.zh: 我们根据需求和交期计算了再订货点。
examples.en: We calculated the reorder point from demand and lead time.

examples.zh: 库存已达到再订货点。
examples.en: Inventory has reached the reorder point.

examples.zh: 小批量提高了库存周转率。
examples.en: Smaller batches improved inventory turnover.

examples.zh: 需求下降后库存周转放缓。
examples.en: Inventory turnover slowed after demand fell.

examples.zh: 逐步停产计划减少了过剩库存。
examples.en: The phase-out plan reduces excess inventory.

examples.zh: 过剩库存占用宝贵空间。
examples.en: Excess inventory occupies valuable space.

examples.zh: 财务部门批准处置过时库存。
examples.en: Finance approved the disposal of obsolete stock.

examples.zh: 过时库存需要处置决定。
examples.en: Obsolete stock requires a disposal decision.

examples.zh: 减少缓冲库存前，我们评估了缺货风险。
examples.en: We assessed stockout risk before lowering the buffer.

examples.zh: 交期长增加缺货风险。
examples.en: Long lead times increase stockout risk.

examples.zh: 对各客户一致应用分配规则。
examples.en: Apply the allocation rule consistently across customers.

examples.zh: 分配规则优先照顾紧急订单。
examples.en: The allocation rule prioritizes urgent orders.

examples.zh: 团队迅速响应了新的需求信号。
examples.en: The team responded quickly to the new demand signal.

examples.zh: 实际消耗提供了需求信号。
examples.en: Actual consumption provides a demand signal.

examples.zh: 供应商将补货周期缩短了三天。
examples.en: The supplier shortened the replenishment cycle by three days.

examples.zh: 补货周期现为一周。
examples.en: The replenishment cycle now takes one week.

examples.zh: 我们按实际波动确定了库存缓冲量。
examples.en: We sized the inventory buffer using actual variability.

examples.zh: 库存缓冲应对了这次延误。
examples.en: The inventory buffer covered the delay.

examples.zh: 写一份行动导向的进展说明，提出三项明确请求。
examples.en: Write an action-oriented update with three clear requests.

examples.zh: 行动导向的进展说明列出负责人。
examples.en: The action-oriented update names responsible owners.

examples.zh: 团队为发起人准备了可供决策的摘要。
examples.en: The team prepared a decision-ready summary for the sponsor.

examples.zh: 可供决策的摘要比较可行选项。
examples.en: A decision-ready summary compares feasible options.

examples.zh: 简短的受众分析改善了演示。
examples.en: A quick audience analysis improved the presentation.

examples.zh: 受众分析帮助选择相关例子。
examples.en: Audience analysis helps select relevant examples.

examples.zh: 评审前，我们进一步明确了核心信息。
examples.en: We sharpened the key message before the review.

examples.zh: 将核心信息放在第一页幻灯片。
examples.en: Keep the key message on the first slide.

examples.zh: 报告以经核实的数据建立支持性论证。
examples.en: The report builds a supporting argument from verified data.

examples.zh: 支持性论证缺少成本证据。
examples.en: The supporting argument lacks cost evidence.

examples.zh: 评审者很容易理解这条推理路径。
examples.en: The reviewer could follow the line of reasoning easily.

examples.zh: 清楚解释你的推理过程。
examples.en: Explain your line of reasoning clearly.

examples.zh: 根据管理层受众调整详细程度。
examples.en: Adjust the level of detail for the executive audience.

examples.zh: 详细程度适合技术评审人员。
examples.en: The level of detail suits technical reviewers.

examples.zh: 用通俗语言解释控制措施变更。
examples.en: Use plain language to explain the control change.

examples.zh: 通俗语言有助于操作员理解。
examples.en: Plain language improves operator understanding.

examples.zh: 为行动标题选择简洁措辞。
examples.en: Choose concise wording for the action title.

examples.zh: 简洁措辞使指示便于浏览。
examples.en: Concise wording makes instructions easier to scan.

examples.zh: 程序必须就拒收给出明确无歧义的指令。
examples.en: The procedure must give an unambiguous instruction for rejection.

examples.zh: 明确无歧义的指令写明所需行动。
examples.en: An unambiguous instruction names the required action.

examples.zh: 重组后，我们审查了管理幅度。
examples.en: We reviewed the span of control after the reorganization.

examples.zh: 更大的管理幅度需要授权。
examples.en: A wider span of control requires delegation.

examples.zh: 明确的上报政策保护了管理精力。
examples.en: A clear escalation policy protects management bandwidth.

examples.zh: 日常争议消耗管理精力与处理能力。
examples.en: Routine disputes consume management bandwidth.

examples.zh: 新章程提高了跨职能角色清晰度。
examples.en: The new charter improved role clarity across functions.

examples.zh: 角色清晰可减少重复审批。
examples.en: Role clarity reduces duplicated approvals.

examples.zh: 分配工作前，确定授权边界。
examples.en: Define the delegation boundary before assigning the work.

examples.zh: 授权边界不包括合同变更。
examples.en: The delegation boundary excludes contract changes.

examples.zh: 采购员未超出权限上限。
examples.en: The buyer stayed within the authority limit.

examples.zh: 权限上限涵盖小额采购。
examples.en: The authority limit covers small purchases.

examples.zh: 为每个关键接口指定上报事项负责人。
examples.en: Name the escalation owner for each critical interface.

examples.zh: 上报事项负责人协调紧急决定。
examples.en: The escalation owner coordinates urgent decisions.

examples.zh: 通过治理议事机制处理跨职能取舍。
examples.en: Use the governance forum for cross-functional trade-offs.

examples.zh: 治理议事会议每月举行。
examples.en: The governance forum meets every month.

examples.zh: 我们向指导小组简报了剩余风险敞口。
examples.en: We briefed the steering group on the remaining exposure.

examples.zh: 指导小组批准了下一阶段。
examples.en: The steering group approved the next phase.

examples.zh: 授权额度减少了决策延迟。
examples.en: A delegated limit reduced decision latency.

examples.zh: 决策延迟拖慢了恢复。
examples.en: Decision latency slowed the recovery.

examples.zh: 修订后的RACI责任矩阵填补了问责空档。
examples.en: The revised RACI closes the accountability gap.

examples.zh: 问责空档使投诉悬而未决。
examples.en: The accountability gap left complaints unresolved.

examples.zh: 工厂在十分钟内启动了事件响应。
examples.en: The plant activated incident response within ten minutes.

examples.zh: 事件响应包含沟通和遏制。
examples.en: Incident response includes communication and containment.

examples.zh: 按照商定标准指定严重等级。
examples.en: Assign a severity level using the agreed criteria.

examples.zh: 严重等级决定响应速度。
examples.en: The severity level determines response speed.

examples.zh: 恢复发货前，我们绘制了影响范围。
examples.en: We mapped the impact radius before resuming shipments.

examples.zh: 影响范围包括两个仓库。
examples.en: The impact radius includes two warehouses.

examples.zh: 损坏的传感器是停机的直接原因。
examples.en: The broken sensor was the immediate cause of the stop.

examples.zh: 直接原因是接线错误。
examples.en: The immediate cause was incorrect wiring.

examples.zh: 仅靠培训无法解决系统性原因。
examples.en: Training alone will not address the systemic cause.

examples.zh: 系统性原因涉及审批控制薄弱。
examples.en: The systemic cause involves weak approval controls.

examples.zh: 评审分别记录了每项促成条件。
examples.en: The review recorded each contributing condition separately.

examples.zh: 能见度差是促成条件之一。
examples.en: Poor visibility was a contributing condition.

examples.zh: 按批次和发货日期确定遏制边界。
examples.en: Define the containment boundary by lot and shipment date.

examples.zh: 遏制边界不包括已验证库存。
examples.en: The containment boundary excludes verified stock.

examples.zh: 我们设定了四小时恢复目标。
examples.en: We set a recovery objective of four hours.

examples.zh: 恢复目标包含最低服务能力。
examples.en: The recovery objective includes minimum service capacity.

examples.zh: 重启前，安全部门批准了恢复运行计划。
examples.en: Safety approved the restoration plan before restart.

examples.zh: 恢复运行计划从设备检查开始。
examples.en: The restoration plan starts with equipment checks.

examples.zh: 我们将于周一进行事件后复盘。
examples.en: We will hold a post-incident review on Monday.

examples.zh: 事件后复盘发现了沟通失误。
examples.en: The post-incident review identified communication failures.

examples.zh: 团队分三阶段管理产量爬坡。
examples.en: The team managed the production ramp-up in three stages.

examples.zh: 产量爬坡需要频繁质量检查。
examples.en: Production ramp-up requires frequent quality checks.

examples.zh: 工时研究改善了生产线平衡。
examples.en: The time study improved line balancing.

examples.zh: 生产线平衡减少工位间等待。
examples.en: Line balancing reduces waiting between stations.

examples.zh: 研讨会以缩短冲床准备时间为目标。
examples.en: The workshop targeted setup reduction on the press.

examples.zh: 准备时间缩减可支持更小生产批量。
examples.en: Setup reduction allows smaller production batches.

examples.zh: 换型时间从上一产品的最后一个合格品产出时起，计至下一产品的首个合格品产出时止。
examples.en: Measure changeover time from the last good piece to the next.

examples.zh: 工装改善后换型时间缩短了。
examples.en: Changeover time fell after tooling improvements.

examples.zh: 我们缩小批量以便更早暴露问题。
examples.en: We reduced the batch size to expose problems earlier.

examples.zh: 批量影响仓储需求。
examples.en: The batch size affects storage needs.

examples.zh: 我们按生产线和班次跟踪产能利用率。
examples.en: We track capacity utilization by line and shift.

examples.zh: 节日旺季产能利用率达到高峰。
examples.en: Capacity utilization peaked during the holiday rush.

examples.zh: 上季度维修部门提高了设备综合效率。
examples.en: Maintenance improved overall equipment effectiveness last quarter.

examples.zh: 设备综合效率计入质量损失。
examples.en: Overall equipment effectiveness includes quality losses.

examples.zh: 我们为校准安排了计划停机。
examples.en: We scheduled planned downtime for calibration.

examples.zh: 计划停机从午夜开始。
examples.en: Planned downtime starts at midnight.

examples.zh: 传感器升级减少了非计划停机时间。
examples.en: The sensor upgrade reduced unplanned downtime.

examples.zh: 非计划停机打乱了交付。
examples.en: Unplanned downtime disrupted deliveries.

examples.zh: 运营部门预订了周日的维护窗口。
examples.en: Operations booked a maintenance window for Sunday.

examples.zh: 维护窗口持续两小时。
examples.en: The maintenance window lasts two hours.

examples.zh: 判断过程前，先进行测量系统分析。
examples.en: Perform a measurement system analysis before judging the process.

examples.zh: 测量系统分析区分设备造成的变差。
examples.en: Measurement system analysis separates equipment variation.

examples.zh: 我们用十个零件检查了量具重复性。
examples.en: We checked gauge repeatability with ten parts.

examples.zh: 稳定夹具提高了量具重复性。
examples.en: Gauge repeatability improved with a stable fixture.

examples.zh: 三名检验员参加了再现性研究。
examples.en: Three inspectors joined the reproducibility study.

examples.zh: 再现性研究比较不同操作员。
examples.en: The reproducibility study compares different operators.

examples.zh: 收集数据前，核实校准状态。
examples.en: Verify calibration status before collecting data.

examples.zh: 标签显示当前校准状态。
examples.en: The label shows current calibration status.

examples.zh: 检验员对每批产品遵循抽样方案。
examples.en: Inspectors followed the sampling plan for each lot.

examples.zh: 抽样方案规定样本数量。
examples.en: The sampling plan specifies sample quantity.

examples.zh: 爬坡期间，我们提高了检查频率。
examples.en: We increased inspection frequency during ramp-up.

examples.zh: 表现稳定后检查频率降低。
examples.en: Inspection frequency decreases after stable performance.

examples.zh: 一个点超过了控制上限。
examples.en: One point exceeded the upper control limit.

examples.zh: 控制限反映正常过程变差。
examples.en: Control limits reflect normal process variation.

examples.zh: 每个受测零件都符合规格限。
examples.en: Every measured part met the specification limit.

examples.zh: 规格限来自设计要求。
examples.en: The specification limit comes from design requirements.

examples.zh: 图表在缺陷出现前发现了过程漂移。
examples.en: The chart detected process drift before defects appeared.

examples.zh: 刀具磨损造成逐渐的过程漂移。
examples.en: Tool wear caused gradual process drift.

examples.zh: 更好的夹具减少了误拒。
examples.en: A better fixture reduced false rejects.

examples.zh: 误判不合格增加不必要的返工。
examples.en: False rejects increase unnecessary rework.

examples.zh: 我们为供应商恢复建立了决策树。
examples.en: We built a decision tree for supplier recovery.

examples.zh: 决策树包含维修选项。
examples.en: The decision tree includes a repair option.

examples.zh: 短期试点在学习过程中保留了选择权价值。
examples.en: A short pilot preserves option value while we learn.

examples.zh: 灵活性增加了合同的选择权价值。
examples.en: Flexibility adds option value to the contract.

examples.zh: 证据改善前，推迟不可逆的决定。
examples.en: Delay the irreversible decision until the evidence improves.

examples.zh: 拆除是一项不可逆的决定。
examples.en: Demolition is an irreversible decision.

examples.zh: 改善数据质量是一项无悔行动。
examples.en: Improving data quality is a no-regret move.

examples.zh: 基础安全培训是一项无悔行动。
examples.en: Basic safety training is a no-regret move.

examples.zh: 我们仅对一条试点线作出最小可行承诺。
examples.en: We made a minimum viable commitment for one pilot line.

examples.zh: 最小可行承诺为初步测试提供资金。
examples.en: The minimum viable commitment funds initial testing.

examples.zh: 启动试验前，确定退出标准。
examples.en: Define an exit criterion before starting the trial.

examples.zh: 退出标准要求产出稳定。
examples.en: The exit criterion requires stable output.

examples.zh: 我们为成本和进度设定了止损点。
examples.en: We set a stop-loss point for cost and schedule.

examples.zh: 试点达到了止损点。
examples.en: The pilot reached its stop-loss point.

examples.zh: 分阶段投资在不确定性下限制风险敞口。
examples.en: Staged investment limits exposure during uncertainty.

examples.zh: 分阶段投资依据已验证的里程碑推进。
examples.en: Staged investment follows verified milestones.

examples.zh: 样本目前尚未达到证据门槛。
examples.en: The sample does not yet meet the evidence threshold.

examples.zh: 批准需要更高的证据门槛。
examples.en: Approval requires a higher evidence threshold.

examples.zh: 临时合同延长了可供决策的时间范围。
examples.en: An interim contract extends the decision horizon.

examples.zh: 决策时间范围止于下季度。
examples.en: The decision horizon ends next quarter.

examples.zh: 项目群建立了每周运营节奏。
examples.en: The program established a weekly operating rhythm.

examples.zh: 运营节奏包含每日检查。
examples.en: The operating rhythm includes daily checks.

examples.zh: 可视化看板加强了车间日常管理。
examples.en: Visual boards strengthened daily management on the floor.

examples.zh: 日常管理揭示逾期行动。
examples.en: Daily management exposes overdue actions.

examples.zh: 团队为隔离材料设置了目视化控制。
examples.en: The team installed a visual control for blocked material.

examples.zh: 彩色标签实现目视化控制。
examples.en: Color labels provide visual control.

examples.zh: 晨会评审使用标准议程。
examples.en: Use a standard agenda for the morning review.

examples.zh: 标准议程以安全事项开始。
examples.en: The standard agenda begins with safety.

examples.zh: 协调员每天维护行动跟踪表。
examples.en: The coordinator maintains the action tracker daily.

examples.zh: 行动跟踪表显示缺失的负责人。
examples.en: The action tracker shows missing owners.

examples.zh: 我们与负责人逐一审查久拖未结事项。
examples.en: We reviewed each aging item with its owner.

examples.zh: 这项久拖未结事项需要管理层关注。
examples.en: This aging item needs management attention.

examples.zh: 团队将逾期待办量减少了一半。
examples.en: The team reduced the overdue balance by half.

examples.zh: 本周逾期待办量增加了。
examples.en: The overdue balance rose this week.

examples.zh: 改变状态前，附上结案证据。
examples.en: Attach closure evidence before changing the status.

examples.zh: 结案证据包含经核实的测试结果。
examples.en: Closure evidence includes verified test results.

examples.zh: 负责人始终将每项行动贯彻到底。
examples.en: The owner showed consistent follow-through on every action.

examples.zh: 可靠的贯彻落实建立客户信任。
examples.en: Reliable follow-through builds customer trust.

examples.zh: 我们对未完成行动进行了问责复盘。
examples.en: We held an accountability review for the missed actions.

examples.zh: 问责复盘澄清了未兑现承诺。
examples.en: The accountability review clarified missed commitments.

examples.zh: 作者说，莫大的讽刺是政策逆转了先前进展。
examples.en: The author says the great irony is that the policy reversed earlier progress.

examples.zh: 莫大的讽刺是自动化反而增加文书工作。
examples.en: The great irony was that automation increased paperwork.

examples.zh: 文章将结果归因于相当数量的选民。
examples.en: The article attributes the outcome to a significant number of voters.

examples.zh: 相当数量的订单延迟到达。
examples.en: A significant number of orders arrived late.

examples.zh: 作者用credulous批评接受承诺的选民。
examples.en: The author uses credulous to criticize voters who accepted the promise.

examples.zh: 轻信的买家可能忽视隐藏费用。
examples.en: Credulous buyers may overlook hidden fees.

examples.zh: 文章回顾了一项迅速降价的承诺。
examples.en: The article recalls a promise to bring prices down quickly.

examples.zh: 他们承诺逐步降低价格。
examples.en: They promised to bring prices down gradually.

examples.zh: 这一承诺被描述为从第一天起生效。
examples.en: The promise was framed as taking effect beginning on day one.

examples.zh: 检查从第一天起实施。
examples.en: Inspections apply beginning on day one.

examples.zh: 文章描述了一次通胀暂时激增。
examples.en: The article describes a temporary surge in inflation.

examples.zh: 暂时激增使仓储能力吃紧。
examples.en: A temporary surge strained warehouse capacity.

examples.zh: 分析指出了供应中断的持续影响。
examples.en: The analysis points to the lingering effects of disruption.

examples.zh: 持续影响拖慢了恢复。
examples.en: Lingering effects slowed the recovery.

examples.zh: 文章说选民因那次激增而责怪一位领导人。
examples.en: The article says voters blamed a leader for the surge.

examples.zh: 不要因指示不明而责怪员工。
examples.en: Do not blame staff for unclear instructions.

examples.zh: 作者认为抗击通胀之战已基本获胜。
examples.en: The author argues that the war against inflation was largely won.

examples.zh: 抗击通胀需要持续努力。
examples.en: The war against inflation requires sustained effort.

examples.zh: 按作者的说法，先前的斗争已基本获胜。
examples.en: By the author's account, the earlier fight had been largely won.

examples.zh: 质量攻坚战已基本获胜。
examples.en: The quality battle was largely won.

examples.zh: 作者说，降低通胀以惊人低的代价取得了成功。
examples.en: The author says disinflation succeeded at startlingly low cost.

examples.zh: 团队以惊人低的代价恢复了服务。
examples.en: The team restored service at startlingly low cost.

examples.zh: 后期政策逆转可能使胜利在望的局面转为失败。
examples.en: A late policy reversal can snatch defeat from the jaws of victory.

examples.zh: 落实不力可能使胜利在望的局面转为失败。
examples.en: Poor follow-through can snatch defeat from the jaws of victory.

examples.zh: 文章提到经济学家之间持续存在的争议。
examples.en: The article notes continuing controversy among economists.

examples.zh: 模型引起了经济学家之间的争议。
examples.en: The model caused controversy among economists.

examples.zh: 作者询问先前政策应为激增承担多少责任。
examples.en: The author asks how much responsibility earlier policies bear for the surge.

examples.zh: 经理对人员配置决定负有责任。
examples.en: Managers bear responsibility for staffing decisions.

examples.zh: 作者称，谁应为再次抬头负责毫无疑问。
examples.en: The author says there is no question who is responsible for the resurgence.

examples.zh: 谁批准了订单毫无疑问。
examples.en: There is no question who approved the order.

examples.zh: 文章警告通胀可能再次抬头。
examples.en: The post warns about a resurgence in inflation.

examples.zh: 需求再度增长耗尽了库存。
examples.en: A resurgence in demand depleted stock.

examples.zh: 作者说，通胀再起全应归咎于现政府。
examples.en: The author says the renewed inflation is all on the current administration.

examples.zh: 排程错误全应由我负责。
examples.en: The scheduling mistake is all on me.

examples.zh: 接连发生的冲击可能改变预期。
examples.en: A succession of shocks can change expectations.

examples.zh: 一连串延误耗尽了缓冲时间。
examples.en: A succession of delays exhausted the buffer.

examples.zh: 家庭可能难以承受又一次通胀冲击。
examples.en: Households may struggle to absorb another inflation shock.

examples.zh: 通胀冲击可能挤压家庭预算。
examples.en: An inflation shock can squeeze household budgets.

examples.zh: 反复冲击可能在预期中变得根深蒂固。
examples.en: Repeated shocks can get entrenched in expectations.

examples.zh: 坏习惯可能随时间变得根深蒂固。
examples.en: Poor habits can get entrenched over time.

examples.zh: 稳定政策有助于锚定通胀预期。
examples.en: Stable policy can help anchor inflation expectations.

examples.zh: 通胀预期影响工资谈判。
examples.en: Inflation expectations influence wage negotiations.

examples.zh: 文章担心可能需要衰退才能使通胀重新下降。
examples.en: The article worries that a recession may be needed to get inflation back down.

examples.zh: 官员力求使通胀重新下降。
examples.en: Officials aim to get inflation back down.

examples.zh: 标题称，这次无法转嫁责任。
examples.en: The title says there is no way to shift the blame this time.

examples.zh: 报告将责任转嫁给供应商。
examples.en: The report shifts the blame to suppliers.

examples.zh: 作者当时在牛津发表纪念演讲。
examples.en: The author was in Oxford to give a memorial lecture.

examples.zh: 她明天将发表纪念演讲。
examples.en: She will give a memorial lecture tomorrow.

examples.zh: 写完简短说明后，作者说今天就到这里。
examples.en: After a concise note, the author says that is all for today.

examples.zh: 今天就到这里，谢谢。
examples.en: That is all for today; thank you.
